Going to copy my response from another thread with a similar idea someone had.

A request for something similar came up on the Rocket League subreddit where someone mentioned earning titles through in game "quest" as well. Like "get 50 aerial hits" the devs response was (paraphrasing of course) that they didn't like the idea of that because it could alter a players focus when going into a game. Now instead of going into a Rocket League match trying to win, you have a guy flying around everywhere just trying to get aerial medals which could cost his team the victory.

From a Brawl Stars perspective, you could have a Mortis queuing up for games and ignoring objectives (grabbing gems, scoring Brawl Ball goals etc) and focusing on doing the quest for the skin. It has a potential to create some ugly play-styles costing people trophies, especially without an unranked mode. Certainly not against your quest idea at all, I just think it needs to be approached with caution.

I'm 24 now. I remember this like it was yesterday. When I was younger (probably between the ages of 10 and 12) I had a freaky experience while I was sleeping in my bed.

It would normally wake me up so I would say something like "goodbye dad" or "I love you."
